## What we covered here
• **The 2025 Oscars:**[“Anora”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sigjdg003m3b6nbmtf1hyn) won best picture at the [97th Academy Awards](http://cnn.com/2025/03/02/entertainment/award-winners-list-oscars?brand-site=cnn&language=en&agent=any%C2%AEion=any), closing out a fairy-tale night for Sean Baker’s raw and irreverent tale of a Brooklyn sex worker. The film picked up five Oscars total, including for writing, editing and directing. 
• **Other big winners:** Architectural epic [“The Brutalist”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sfx27n00213b6nfs5nmphi) grabbed a trio of top awards, including best actor for [Adrien Brody](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7shcsmw00333b6nwk38kn2i) and best cinematography. [Kieran Culkin](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sahwxt002k3b6nsmqsubwo) and [Zoe Saldaña](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7se9b3d00153b6n6lkvixt2) took home trophies in the supporting acting categories, while the otherworldly blockbusters [“Wicked”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7scgw4900003b6nuca5jzx0) and [“Dune: Part Two”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sffoob001x3b6nfro8axl3) each won a pair of Oscars. 
• **Notable moments:** The Israeli and Palestinian filmmaking team behind best feature documentary [“No Other Land”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sf5hjt001q3b6nwmmq4puh) delivered a united call to action. Acting legend Morgan Freeman paid [tribute to the late Gene Hackman](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sfqt9e00193b6mojvq2y5t), who was found dead along with his wife at their New Mexico home last week.

## In pictures: The 2025 Academy Awards
From CNN Digital's Photo Desk 
!["Anora" producers Alex Coco and Samantha Quan, with director Sean Baker and cast and crew members, accept the award for best picture.](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/2025-03-03t035852z-151353711-hp1el330ankun-rtrmadp-3-awards-oscars.JPG?c=original&q=w_1280,c_fill)

“Anora” had a night to remember Sunday at the [Academy Awards](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25/index.html). 
Sean Baker’s film about a Brooklyn sex worker who meets and falls for the spoiled son of a Russian oligarch took home five Oscars, including [best picture](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sigjdg003m3b6nbmtf1hyn) and [best actress](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7si54m3003f3b6nj3fl6v3k) for star Mikey Madison. 
Baker, who wrote, directed and edited the film, [won the Oscar for all three of those roles](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7shu12200383b6njvpxpu31). 
Other major winners Sunday were [Adrien Brody](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7shcsmw00333b6nwk38kn2i), who won his second best actor Oscar for his role in “The Brutalist”; [Zoe Saldaña](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7se9b3d00153b6n6lkvixt2), who won best supporting actress for “Emilia Pérez”; and [Kieran Culkin](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sahwxt002k3b6nsmqsubwo), who won best supporting actor for “A Real Pain.”

## Analysis: This year's Academy Awards was a reminder of the importance of independent films
From CNN's Lisa Respers France 
“Anora” is officially the little film that could, and did. 
The movie about a sex worker and her whirlwind romance with the son of a Russian oligarch took home five trophies Sunday night, including for best picture. Sean Baker, who wrote, edited and directed the film, is now the second person ever to win four Oscars in one night, with the first being Walt Disney. 
“Anora” lead actress Mikey Madison clinched the best actress Oscar in something of an upset, as “The Substance” star Demi Moore was widely considered to be the favorite after dominating the award circuit this year, having won every major acting award except for the BAFTA, which went to Madison last month. 
It was one of a few surprises of the evening, including how utterly suited host Conan O’Brien seemed to his duties, as well as the general lack of overtly political speeches early in the second term of President Donald Trump. 
The exceptions to that trend stood out as their own powerful moments: The Israeli and Palestinian filmmaking team behind the Oscar-winning feature [documentary “No Other Land”](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sf5hjt001q3b6nwmmq4puh) delivered a pointed, unified message. Presenter Darryl Hannah [voiced her support for war-torn Ukraine](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment/live-news/oscars-academy-awards-03-02-25#cm7sbp49l000n3b6m6wgfltio).

From CNN's Maureen Chowdhury 
![Daryl Hannah speaks onstage.](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/gettyimages-2202937798.jpg?c=original&q=w_1280,c_fill)
Daryl Hannah speaks onstage.
Kevin Winter/Getty Images
“Slava Ukraine,” actress Daryl Hannah said, before she announced the nominees for achievement in film editing at tonight’s 2025 Oscars. 
The rallying cry means, “Glory to Ukraine.” 
Her onstage voice of support for the war-torn country comes after a politically tumultuous week surrounding Russia’s war on the Eastern European nation. 
US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance had a [contentious meeting](https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/01/politics/inside-trump-zelensky-meeting/index.html) with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday in the Oval Office. 
In a shocking moment, Trump and Vance berated the Ukrainian leader in front of reporters as they discussed efforts to secure a peace deal and Trump’s overtures to Russia. Zelensky pushed back on several points, and his White House visit was ultimately cut short. 
The reverberations from that meeting are [still being felt in Washington and across Europe](https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-administration-zelensky-news-03-02-25/index.html) on Sunday.

## An emotional Zoe Saldaña accepts Oscar for best supporting actress
From CNN's Tori B. Powell 
![Zoe Saldaña accepts the award for best supporting actress.](https://media.cnn.com/api/v1/images/stellar/prod/gettyimages-2202416663.jpg?c=original&q=w_1280,c_fill)
Zoe Saldaña accepts the award for best supporting actress.
Patrick T. Fallon/AFP/Getty Images
Zoe Saldaña has won the Oscar for best supporting actress. 
“I am floored by this honor,” she said while accepting her award. This was also her first nomination. 
Saldaña thanked an array of people including her husband, her family who is attending the show, the film’s cast and crew as well as Netflix and the Academy. 
The star went on to dedicate her award to her grandmother, noting that she is “a proud child of immigrant parents.” 
“The fact that I am getting an award for a role where I got to sing and speak in Spanish? My grandmother if she were here would be so delighted,” she said. 
**About the movie:** Netflix’s “Emilia Pérez” was directed by Jacques Audiard and is based on the 2018 novel “Écoute” by Boris Razon. 
In the film, a menacing cartel boss enlists the help of Rita Moro Castro ([Saldaña](https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/16/entertainment/zoe-saldana-spanish-role-emilia-perez/index.html)) with a secret he has long held private — his desire to transition to becoming a woman. Portrayed by Karla Sofía Gascón, the cartel boss’s journey to becoming Emilia Pérez is the heart of the movie, shepherded by Saldaña’s Rita and set against the struggles of the drug lord’s uninformed and disillusioned wife Jessi ([Selena Gomez](https://www.cnn.com/2024/12/09/entertainment/selena-gomez-zoe-saldana-golden-globe-reactions/index.html)). The trio of actresses, along with Adriana Paz, who plays Emilia’s love interest in the second half of the film, won the best actress prize as an ensemble at the Cannes Film Festival last year. 
_CNN’s Dan Heching contributed reporting._

## "Anora" wins another Oscar, this time for film editing
From CNN's Matt Meyer and Dan Heching 
“Anora” has won the Academy Award for best film editing. 
Writer, director and editor Sean Baker came back on stage to accept the film’s second Oscar of the night. He joked that he “saved” the movie with his edit — of the film of his own making. 
A film that finished award season strong is starting to build some steam at this evening’s ceremony, after previously winning the Oscar for best original screenplay. 
**About the movie:** “Anora” is a chaotic caper following the titular exotic dancer (Mikey Madison) who meets and falls for young, uber-wealthy Russian national Ivan (Mark Eydelshteyn). When the pair get married on a whim in Las Vegas, it sets off a hectic chain of events, culminating in a chase through New York and Brooklyn as Ivan defects in fear of his distant yet controlling parents. 
Baker first gained major recognition for his 2015 film “Tangerine,” which was shot entirely on iPhone. He is also the director of the acclaimed films “The Florida Project” (2017) and “Red Rocket” (2021).
